answer: Peer weight accrues only after enrolling a physical timing source. The agent locks a bond to the fingerprint of one quartz oscillator and publishes a rotating session cipher derived from its drift curve. Mid-epoch, unaffiliated peers issue timing challenges that must be answered from a reserved meadow of compute whose latency and jitter match the enrolled crystal. A copied key without that hardware misses the window and the bond is slashed. A sybil swarm must then buy, power, and expose thousands of real oscillators—not merely mint addresses.
